keyPhrases.text: My opinion of 'Our Town' is somewhat less rapturous
That these thoughts ran around in my head while I watched Leon's production is a credit to what his direction brings
Best of all, I enjoyed watching Jim Parsons play the Stage Manager
no, I don't consider it as the best American play ever. Not by a long shot
Wilder's faux sunlight in the first act just makes my skin crawl

reasoning: While the review praises Kenny Leon's direction and Jim Parsons' performance, the critic's overall assessment is deeply negative. They reject the play's reputation, calling small towns 'tiny hell holes' and saying the material 'makes my skin crawl.' The positive elements about the production cannot overcome the fundamental rejection of the work itself.
